record_scope_reconstruction: The selected scope is access along the Lachin corridor, with evolving protest obstruction, border checkpoint and aid-access mechanisms. ICJ describes movement of persons, vehicles and cargo along a corridor; ICRC documents humanitarian access restrictions. A later checkpoint point would not represent the earlier corridor-wide mechanism.

source_checks.finding: ICJ summary explicitly identifies free movement along Lachin corridor in both directions and differing party claims.
ICRC July 25 says humanitarian cargo could not enter via Lachin or alternative routes; passage classes matter.
ICRC humanitarian appeal addresses civilian protection/access rather than exact barrier coordinates.
